title: More Workers Are Using AI — But Many Don't Know Why
paragraphs: Many companies are encouraging their workers to use artificial intelligence (AI). But according to a new study, a lot of workers are not sure why they should use it.
The study was published by Culture Amp, a company that helps businesses understand their employees. It surveyed about 112,000 workers at more than 100 companies around the world.

The study found that 85% of workers are actively encouraged to try AI at work. However, 42% said they do not know why their company wants them to use it. Only 58% said their leaders had explained why the company wants to use AI, and 60% said their managers had shown them examples of how AI can help with their work.
Still, many workers feel that AI is useful. Around 71% of all workers said AI tools help them feel more productive. Among workers who use AI the most, that number rose to 93%.
Interestingly, using AI did not seem to make a big difference to workload. About 69% of workers who do not use AI said their workload was reasonable, compared with 72% of heavy AI users.
Workers are also aware of the dangers of AI. Around 86% said they understand the risks of using it. Among workers who do not use AI, the number was 67%, while among the heaviest users, it was 95%.

Amy Lavoie, a vice president at Culture Amp, said workers have done their part and are now waiting for leaders to do theirs. Lavoie explained that leaders are being asked to explain a future that no one can see clearly yet. Lavoie's advice to leaders is to admit that their plan is not finished, and to keep talking with their workers anyway. According to Lavoie, what employees need right now is honesty, not certainty.
